x: Brian Morris finished 2nd to Nick Overhead (Watford) in Invitation 400 m. at White City on August Bank Holiday Monday with a time of 48.3. Gerry North finished behind Batty and Snowden in the rain-spoiled 5,000m,clocking 14:30.6.

This is always a high-class field and when runners like Cooke (Portsmouth), O'Sullivan (Oxford ),Franklin (Tipton), Hill-Cottingham (Chelms) and Snowden (Surrey) all finish in the thirties, it is decidedly tough.
Taylor (HHH) took the field thro' the first mile in 4:17, but with 2 laps to go Bill Kerr took over and led at the bell, with Tulloh close by and Taylor and Snowden a couple of yards back.
Snowden clipped 6 seconds from this but our winning margin was still a fine achievement over a fine team. The first 2 teams broke the course record.
At the end of the first lap Roath (Walton) Snowden (Surrey) and Tony Milner (Walton) were contesting the lead with our own Gerry North a little way behind, but by no means out of touch.
